page_title: NAP 2-1 VER | Napoli v Verona 04/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends a chip pass into the box, but Pierluigi Gollini is quickest to intercept the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' 2 - 1 Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) finds some space on the edge of the penalty box and smashes the ball into the top right corner! What a beauty!
86' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Ondrej Duda is replaced by Elayis Tavsan (Verona).
85' Walter Mazzarri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) replacing Giovanni Simeone.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Coppola trots off the pitch and is replaced by Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona).
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leander Dendoncker (Napoli) will replace Stanislav Lobotka.

83' What a wasted opportunity by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli)! He creates himself some space inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the top of the net, but Lorenzo Montipo makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
82' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
82' A substitution has been made. Tomas Suslov goes off and Daniel Silva (Verona) comes on.
81' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Darko Lazovic and he is replaced by Ruben Vinagre (Verona).
79' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) puts the ball into his own net.
78' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

78' Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the top of the net, but the Lorenzo Montipo pulled off a nice save. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
76' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
72' 0 - 1 GOAL! Tomas Suslov curls the free kick into the box. Diego Coppola (Verona) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Pierluigi Gollini and into the left side of the net. 0:1.
72' It seemed like Tomas Suslov (Verona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
66' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
62' Walter Mazzarri decides to make a substitution. Jens Cajuste will be replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
62' Matteo Politano comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli).
61' The linesman points to the corner flag, Verona are going to take it.
60' That will be all from Tijjani Noslin who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Karol Swiderski (Verona).

57' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
55' Matteo Politano (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
54' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) blows a big chance from close range. World class save by the goalkeeper.
54' Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
54' The game is interrupted. Tomas Suslov (Verona) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
53' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
52' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mario Rui departs the field of play to be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
49' Juan David Cabal (Verona) shows good awareness inside the box to meet a delightful cross from the free kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the right post.
49' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.

48' Darko Lazovic (Verona) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Pierluigi Gollini stops the ball from going inside the left post. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Verona.

47' Diego Coppola (Verona) has a big opportunity! He finds some space for a shot inside the penalty box after collecting a lofted pass and sends the ball narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
46' Verona are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
46' Mario Rui (Napoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+3' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
45+2' Mario Rui (Napoli) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Darko Lazovic (Verona) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
44' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

43' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
41' The referee blows his whistle as Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge. Napoli get a free kick.
36' Marco Baroni is stunned as referee Marco Piccinini shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
34' The ball goes out of play and Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
33' We are about to witness a long-range indirect free kick by Napoli. From a position like this it's difficult to score.
33' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Diego Coppola (Verona) was quite harsh and Marco Piccinini didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
31' Suat Serdar (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Pierluigi Gollini, who smothers the ball.
27' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.
24' Mario Rui (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Lorenzo Montipo comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' A rebound sits up perfectly for Tijjani Noslin (Verona), who connects nicely with the ball from mid-range but sends it miles wide of the right post.
20' Napoli are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

16' Matteo Politano (Napoli) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Verona.

13' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save.
13' Napoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.

10' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Napoli.
9' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
8' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
6' Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.
4' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
3' Napoli are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
